set.body: Release review found 18 open GitHub dependency alerts (nine Pillow advisories in two manifests). Upgrade Pillow 12.3.0 to the first patched 13.0.0 without upgrading unrelated packages; regenerate the hash lock using uv; update the bound performance protocol dependency identity and package version. Preserve all previous measurements unchanged and explicitly require new receipts to use the new identity. Verify environment resolution and existing protocol/collector tests. Keep open until qualified landing and remote alert rescan.
set.title: Upgrade the release Python tool environments to patched Pillow
